blockers.description: gap_contradicts_prior requires h_bounded_above (exists y > a with NOT contemp_equiv), but contemp_equiv is trivially true for all bounded subintervals. The entire model surgery framework only detects differences between unbounded structures. A fundamentally different proof approach is needed: either omega-chain stage induction or a connectivity lemma on limit_dom.
